notes.title: Punch Club 2: Fast Forward Version 1.108 is now live
notes.content:
Hey Champs!

We hope you’re having a good time in the gym (or at school, or in your offices!) and enjoying Punch Club 2: Fast Forward. 

We continue to improve the game based on your feedback (please do continue to send it our way!) and today we’re releasing a small but important update.

QOL Improvements
New difficulty selection
We’ve redesigned the difficulty selection and walkthrough choice windows that you see before starting the game. These windows are now more visually clear, so no more miss-clicks! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661948/38d91bafe0959f8054dd681ba20bc190cf59cd35.png
Added an "Ok" button to the Options window
Yes, it wasn’t there before, making it hard to understand if you’ve confirmed the changes or not. Don’t ask why…

Bug fixes

 Fixed several translation typos and improved localization for multiple languages.
 Made minor adjustments to the Ladders windows.
 Corrected the display of player buffs during robot fights.
 Fixed an issue where Ruth's (Yoga Girl) fight event and subsequent chain of events could re-trigger.
 Fixed incorrect player movement display during conversations with Mick via Pip-Boy in certain events.

notes.title: Quality of Fight Patch out now!
notes.content:
Hey Champs!

We've got some bug fixes and handy quality of life improvements for you in this patch for Punch Club 2: Fast Forward, including the option to start a new game at the point you can start the DLC! Here’s what’s new:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661948/917f629a68332617d8bf2b06d4ef7b1bdf389001.png

Main Game Update:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661948/4640da65d8b8e45d0ddb905395f1678b82b668b2.png

There will be a new option when you choose to start a new game - “Skip Beginning” will skip Silvers League and start you out in the game at the beginning of the Iron Fist DLC. Don’t worry! You’ll be appropriately leveled for the stage of the game, and will be able to customize your fighter's stats and moves etc. with 2000GPP to spend as you choose. 	

https://i.imgur.com/EAfVQLk.gif

As well, when you approach the final stage of the game, a new window will appear warning you: "The final stage of the game is starting now. All side quests will become unavailable. Are you sure you want to continue?" with options to select Yes or No.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661948/1a5aaa123ed09a0b287b8fb053f46efe390f4220.png

DLC Save Management Improvements:

Loading saves with the DLC after the Final Stage has started:

If you have the DLC and try to load a save where the DLC cannot be started, a new window will appear with the following options:
[olist]
 Load Save Anyway
 Cancel
 Start a New Game (DLC-Ready New Game): This option skips the progression to the Chapter "Big Enough" (after completing Silver's League).
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661948/481d7f23625ae48625d684475443f0844bb2ecee.png

Loading saves with DLC active after the Final Stage has begun:

If you try to load a save file where the DLC is already started but can't be finished due to the final stage of the game already beginning, you will see a similar window with the same buttons but slightly different text.

Bug Fixes

We’ve also addressed several issues to improve your gameplay experience:


 Shortened the description of "Lock-on Guidance" in German ("Zielhilfe").
 Fixed the perk "Self-Repair System" for the Final Boss.
 Fixed the attack abilities for "Apu Slime Warchief".
 Fixed the dialogue bubbles bug in the final cut-scene.
 Fixed the bug with swapping skill sets in custom ladders.
 Fixed the passive HP restoration bug in custom leagues.

We hope these little improvements make everyone’s lives a little easier! If you find any bugs or issues, please let us know, either through the steam forums or our discord!

Have an awesome day Champs!

notes.title: The Ultimate Guide to Custom Leagues
notes.content:
Hey Champs!

With the release of the Iron Fist DLC for Punch Club 2: Fast Forward, we’ve also released a massive patch for everyone to enjoy! This free update contains bug fixes, new custom leagues and quality of life improvements, making Punch Club 2: Fast Forward as awesome as we can make it!

Bug Fixes and Quality of Life
The new update contains a lot of bug fixes. We really mean a lot - it was multiple pages of small text just for the major ones, so we’re not going to worry about telling you about them all - just know that Punch Club 2: Fast Forward will now run more smoothly than it ever has before, and you should see less annoying bugs! If you still encounter any, make sure to report them on our Discord server!

We’ve also included a bunch of quality-of-life features in the patch - just things to make playing the game a little less hassle. A great example of this is the fact that in the upgrade menu, if you hover over a move, the tooltip will now tell you if it's an attack/dodge/block, what it’s attacking, if it’s a modifier etc. This should make building your fighter a much less bothersome process!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661948/8a7c7db66276235b048e5cc83bb5eaa28d04ccad.png

Custom Leagues!
One of the things we’ve been asked for most since the release of Punch Club 2: Fast Forward is the ability to create and then share your own leagues with other players. 

Good news everyone! We listened, and with this patch, you’ll be able to create your own leagues by launching the game with the latest update on Steam. Unfortunately, due to platform limitations, custom leagues do not work on consoles. 

Once in the game, you’ll notice a new button in the main menu labelled ‘Ladders’. Click it to dive into the world of custom leagues.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661948/6a2065ee8fd0eea253c72321358f99f9f85d9e91.png

In the ‘Ladders’ section, you’ll find all available leagues organized by tabs: recent leagues, leagues from Steam, and league creation. You can search for specific leagues by name and filter them by author (all, friends, mine) and by the number of fighters (4-6, 6-8, 9-11). For each league, you can see the player's score and progress, rating, number of votes, and the author who published it.

Creating A Custom League Of Your Own
Ready to create your own league? Head over to the ‘Create’ tab and click ‘Add’. In the window that opens, you can craft a league to your liking. 

https://i.imgur.com/3QayslE.gif

Don’t forget to customize the appearance and starting stats for your player character in the league. You can choose between a human or a robot (which is fully customisable), and set the number of stat points and tech points available from the start.

https://i.imgur.com/AhtwICl.gif

Once you’ve crafted your league and given it a name, you need to beat the league yourself before publishing. After completing it, you can choose to either publish or edit your league. If you exit, your league will remain in the ‘Create’ tab, ready for you to return and make further tweaks at any time.


First, add opponents to the league – there can be from 5 to 11 of them. Press the ‘Add new fighter’ button to begin customizing each fighter's appearance or let the game's randomness decide for you. You can tweak each fighter’s head, arms, torso, and legs, and even paint any part of their body! If you're not satisfied with the result, simply reset all settings.

https://i.imgur.com/lRTUlM1.gif

Next, configure each opponent’s starting stats in terms of strength, agility, and stamina, and set the rewards for defeating them. Give each opponent an original name and choose a fighting style school or assign punch cards, which act as perks. Customize their default techniques, selecting strikes, defenses, and modifiers, which can be mixed regardless of the selected school or punch cards. It’s crucial to assign techniques to opponents; otherwise, the league cannot be published.

https://i.imgur.com/kdmJqAW.gif

For an extra layer of strategy, set up scenarios for enemy behavior. For example, configure what happens when an opponent's energy drops below 100 points or their health below 60. You can create up to three scenarios, but this is optional and purely for expanding your creative possibilities.

https://i.imgur.com/R2xjegI.gif

How To Share Your Custom Leagues
Once you’ve created and then beaten your custom league, you’ll be able to share it with the Punch Club 2 community. After you successfully complete your custom league, you’ll be presented with two options: ‘Publish’ or ‘Edit’. If you choose to publish, your league will become available for others to see and play.

If you need to make further adjustments, you can select ‘Edit’ to fine-tune your league. If you exit without publishing, don’t worry—your league won’t disappear. It will remain in the ‘Create’ tab, allowing you to return and edit it at any time.

[hr][/hr]
So now you know how to create, beat and share your custom leagues, champs! 
So what are you waiting for? We can’t wait to see what challenges you all dream up for everyone! We’ll see you in the ring Champs!

Join the fun and conversations on our Discord Server and follow us on X

notes.title: First look at the Punch Club 2: Iron Fist DLC
notes.content:
Hey Champs!

The Punch Club 2: Iron Fist Expansion DLC is coming on July 22nd, and today we wanted to provide you with a first look at what to expect from it, including some of the core features of this new adventure! 

New Story Content
Once you meet Emmit in the original Punch Club 2: Fast Forward story, you'll receive a leaflet delivered to your home in the garage. If you have finished the game, load an old save file to access the DLC; look for an icon indicating its availability on the load screen. Note that if you start the ""Down the Memory Lane"" quest, the DLC will not be accessible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661948/91527085c9b831a340d3c2d3d0cdfb478ee12238.jpg
After picking up the leaflet, you'll discover it's for the new Robot League. Shortly after, you'll receive a call from Emmit, asking you to meet him at the Dream Lab. Upon your arrival, your new adventure into the world of fighting robots in the Iron Fist DLC will begin!

From there you’ll unlock new locations, upgrade your robot, make the best popcorn the world has ever seen and… plug a fully functioning AI into the internet? That’s surely a good idea..

The Warehouse
One of the first things you’ll do in Iron Fist is unlock the new Warehouse Facility. Here, you’ll meet your fighter robot, not in the best shape, but excited to finally get out there and show the world what a Robot with Dreams can do! You’ll also find all of the tools necessary to upgrade your robot, but we’ll get more into that in a second! 

https://i.imgur.com/ZeOwcbk.gif

As well, in the Warehouse, you’ll find MoMMi, the AI who will help guide you through this adventure and has no nefarious intentions whatsoever. You’ll also be able to enter the robot into fights in the robot league from this oh-so-glamorous new location, which, incidentally, is also upgradeable.

Upgradeable Robot
When you arrive at the Warehouse, you’ll find an old Robot that needs to be trained, charged and repaired. All of the tools you need to do so are in the Warehouse, but, at the start, your robot is going to be unable to beat much more than a fly in a fight, if it could even hit the thing.

https://i.imgur.com/1yzj4aj.gif

You’ll need to train your robot, either via VR personally or passively over time while you’re doing other things. Once your robot's stats don’t suck, you’ll be able to start entering it into fights, unlocking Badass Robot Points (BRP) for victories in the Robot League, which you can then spend on the new fight path for the robot - more on that in a second!

https://i.imgur.com/9lI5b0U.gif

You’ll also unlock punch cards, which are a bit like the bonuses from fight schools in the main game, but are customisable, so you can really make your robot suit your fighting style. As well, you’ll be able to customise the look of your robot, with customisable body parts and colours! And even better, as a bonus, when it’s not fighting, the robot can work for you, earning you some resources on the side!

New Fight Path
The robot has access to its own fight path, which, like in the main game, lets you spend currency to unlock new moves, skills and buffs for use in the fights. 

https://i.imgur.com/hLeAfWh.gif

This skill path is totally unique for the robot and contains a plethora of moves and skills for you to try, test, and play around with to create the ultimate fighting machine!

And that’s a wrap fight fans! 
We hope you enjoyed this look at the Punch Club 2: Iron Fist DLC, coming on July 22nd - don’t forget to wishlist it here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923090/Punch_Club_2_Iron_Fist/

Join the fun and conversations on our Discord Server and follow us on X

notes.title: A balance update and a special message from the development team
notes.content:
Hey, Champs!

It’s been a few weeks since we released Punch Club 2: Fast Forward on all platforms, and we’d like to take this moment to thank each and every one of you who have played the game so far and supported us! We’ve been constantly going through your valuable feedback, evaluating it, addressing minor (and tricky) issues and building the plans for future updates.

https://i.imgur.com/yVf6LBj.gif

Today we're also releasing an update that is designed to balance out individual game mechanics, add a few quality-of-life improvements and fix a bunch of bugs. Let’s talk about it in detail!

Balance changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661948/cf7467f68dd08fe49ac347128de79640f7886e9e.png
Neurotraining cost
We've noticed that a fair number of players prefer traditional gym workouts to neurotraining (although in the long run or if you're a speedrunner - neurotraining is much more effective, just saying) or avoid neuroimaging completely for a variety of reasons. 

In this update, neurotraining will become 25% cheaper (this special deal is valid when you purchase an annual gym membership… Just kidding!). We hope this change will bring back the popularity of this new kind of exercise in the gym of the future.

Progress Bar in Mick’s Old House and Police Station
If you look at most of the negative reviews (thank you so much for them! We read ABSOLUTELY ALL of them and have taken a lot of things into consideration), we can see that players encountered a slowdown in story progression and suffered from the monotonous repetition of the same actions (we were specifically asked to avoid the word GRIND in communication, but you get the idea).

And although we originally envisioned this approach somewhere around the middle of League 2, in this update, we decided to adjust the speed of progression through activities and the story slightly. So now the global progression speed in The Police and Mick’s Old House is faster by 25%. Here. Use your saved time wisely! 

GPP
We've also adjusted the amount of GPP points you gain (and lose) per fight. Pro-League progression will now be faster, and you'll get more GPP points for winning. But you'll lose more GPP if you fail. Did we mention this update is about balancing things out?


We want to see how these changes will affect the game in the long term, and we are willing to adjust them in the future to achieve proper balance across all systems. Please share your feedback and let us know your thoughts on our official Discord server or on the Steam forums!

And here are the details:

QoL Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661948/a2f33e470b4b1cb8f42f23fc44111f83c2dacce2.png
Added Clippy softlock escape feature

 Additional softlock escape if the player empties both their food and money reserves. Clippy will now appear and save them. 
Added skip option for cinematics

 Some people asked for this, so we added it.

Balance Improvements
Neurotraining price is now 25% lower

 So the “Police-Neurotraining Path” is more accessible. 
More GPP increase for wins, more GPP decrease for losses

 Made the “steps” in Pro-league bigger. You get more GPP for winning and lose more GPP for losing.
Mick’s Old House & Police Work global progression is now 25% faster

 The global progression speed in Police and Mick’s Old House is faster. (This should feel much less grindy).

Bug Fixes and Graphical Additions
Fixed unlocking achievements for demo saves

 If you continue playing a Demo save you will get all the achievements that you achieved in the Demo.
Fixed player sometimes getting stuck after training ends

 Training in Mick’s Gym will no longer cause the game to get stuck.
‘Pizza for Barry’ quest now removes pizza from inventory after giving it to Barry

Fixed an issue that could cause a softlock after beating Aesop but still sitting in 2nd position in the league

Fixed Apu & Adriana event start bugging in a few cases

Fixed unlocking the Dream Lab if the police track is followed exclusively

 If the player ignored Mick's quests, they wouldn’t unlock the Dream Lab scene.
Fixed edge cases where locations for side quests would not unlock

Fixed an issue that could make it impossible to join the pro league

Added dialogue if the player beats Jai

 If you manage to beat Jai, there is now dialogue to reflect that you won. (Initially, he was conceived to be invincible, but some of you have somehow managed to defeat him…….)
Added sparring guys in Silver's Ring

 Just a visual in Silver’s Ring scene.
New animations on various characters

 Minor thing, but the animations are cool :-) 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661948/def804485326af4849033c20186b2aa28a5c52cf.gif

[hr][/hr]
Don't forget to join our official Discord server for some fun and follow us on X (remember we were joking about Twitter in our previous message? Haha), Facebook and Instagram!

We’ll see you in the gym!

notes.title: Version 1.001
notes.content:
Fresh from the oven - first patch! 
Thank you all for all your feedback and bug reports - you are helping us make Punch Club 2: Fast Forward even better! 

So, you probably want to know what are the updates. Here you go, champ!
-First, we fixed some crashes during the start. So now some of you may finally answer the call of Punch Club! 
-No more unexpected calls during the first training in your own fight school or during Police Duty. All of that requires some serious concentration and nobody should interrupt you. 
-We talked to Silver and he promised he will share his thoughts and feelings only one time after you win a fight against Boris. He clearly was a little bit overwhelmed when you took care of that customer complaint from Boris. 
- The Night Club fight scene is now polished and looks good. 
-Added VR fight track to keep you motivated!
-Also added some additional animations to the game because you know, we draw a lot of stuff for the game and would like to share it with you :)

That's all for today, champs! See ya in Punch Club 2!

notes.title: Demo update v 0.104
notes.content:
Oh my oh my it's an update time, champs! 

We got smashing positive feedback from our demo, so thank you, everyone, for your bug reports! You are helping us improve Punch Club 2: fast Forward and we are eternally grateful for that, keep going!

So back to the changes. In our completely new 0.104 demo build we:

 added an easy mode for everyone to enjoy the game <3
 added Polish and Ukrainian localization. Miłej gry, our Polish players, and Гарної гри our Ukrainian players! 
 added a game preview window at the end of the demo. Oh yeah, now we look even more tempting to pre-order! I mean did you see those animations?  
 added energy info for empty attack slots. Now you will see how many energy points you will restore if the slot is empty.  
 fixed active demo version after finishing the first Casey meet event.
 fixed fps limit with disabled vsync. Enjoy our game at maximum fps running smoothly. 
 fixed buying items throw multianswers multiple times.
 fixed demo end event started during a fight (yeah that also happened with the best of us).
 fixed robot assassin animations. Please don't ask what happened, it's classified by the Mafia. 
 fixed the main menu appearing over the game. Probably some glitches of eye implants. Note to self: don't buy them under the bridge again. Two times are enough!  
 called a carpenter and he fixed a few door movement issues (thanks Iliya!)
 fixed a call from Silver and Lil Bobo at one time. In the cyberfuture, there should be no group calls apparently.

notes.title: Punch Club 2: Fast Forward Old School Points Dev Blog
notes.content:
Hey There Champs!


Step into the Timeless Realm of Old School Points: A Cinematic Journey to Power

In the vibrant city where nostalgia intertwines with modern life, an extraordinary opportunity awaits. Meet Henry, your cinema-obsessed neighbour who dwells in the enchanting world of 1980s movies. Prepare to embark on an exhilarating quest that will not only transport you to the era of epic action films but also grant you unimaginable power. Welcome to the realm of Old School Points (OSP), where cinematic dreams become a reality.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661948/6c44df512300fce3b8ebd83da178f932421d2224.jpg

Henry, your guide through this captivating journey, possesses an encyclopedic knowledge of the 80s cinema scene. His passion for those mesmerising action-packed flicks is infectious, and he's more than willing to share his love for the classics with a fellow enthusiast like yourself. Join forces with Henry, grab a bowl of popcorn, and let the magic of the silver screen ignite your adventure.

To unlock a vast collection of movies, you'll need to strike a deal with the enigmatic Apu, the mysterious store owner harbouring a hidden trove of old films. While these cinematic treasures may be considered obsolete in the modern day, their true value lies in their ability to grant you OSP. Be wary, however, for Apu's keen eye for profit might just lead to a price that rivals the most infamous movie heists.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661948/8f6e09db0b78ef08b2328c012dd2d882cee0e406.jpg

Each movie you watch with Henry becomes a gateway to untold power. The wonders of the silver screen manifest themselves as buffs, offering a plethora of benefits to enhance your fighter. From expanding your inventory capacity to supercharging your training methods and even boosting your travel speed, the OSP you acquire through cinematic immersion holds the key to unlocking these extraordinary abilities.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661948/866ca6d9e836c1a03acaf12329adcab86b7389f4.jpg

As your journey unfolds, an exciting new chapter will reveal itself: Mick's Gym. This iconic establishment will become your training ground, honing your skills and fortifying your character. The more time you dedicate to the demanding tasks within the gym's hallowed halls, the greater your OSP reserves will become. This newfound wealth of points will grant you access to the many treasures you've unlocked, ensuring that your journey through the realm of Old School Points reaches unprecedented heights.

Stay tuned for future Dev Blogs, where we'll delve deeper into the mysteries of Mick's Gym and unveil both late-game job opportunities - the other one will remain a mystery for now!. 

Embrace the power of Old School Points and relish in the enchantment of 80s movie magic. Your destiny awaits, intertwined with the immortal legends that shaped a generation. Are you ready to seize the moment and become the hero of your own cinematic adventure? It's time to step into the spotlight and let the symphony of the 80s guide you to victory.

Let the games begin!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661948/030f7e2af8d5acaebdee9053b8b164799167960d.jpg

And that’s everything for this week! Make sure you wishlist the game here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1161590/Punch_Club_2_Fast_Forward/ 

See you next week Champs!

notes.title: Punch Club 2: Fast Forward Neurotraining Dev Blog
notes.content:
Hey there champs!
So you've heard about Punch Club 2: Fast Forward, and now you’ve got your sights set on becoming the best around, knowing nothing is ever going to keep you down. The issue may well be however, that while you have the eye of a tiger, you have the body of a sloth and the fitness of one too… Well, fret not, because this is the future, and we have solutions for that, as long, of course, as you have the money. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661948/fa2ba90f8f89fab20aa64e5f4979012cb13119f3.gif

Our hero can buy fitness machinery from the Mafia for his “Gym” (His Mum’s Garage) and do a montage like he was in a 1980s boxing film, trading pain for gain in a slow, old fashioned and “reliable, safe, time tested way”. But really, is that something you want to bother with, given this is the FUTURE? The Corporation has made sure that you have something to do every waking moment - so who on earth has time for working out the old fashioned way? 


Welcome to the future
Well, good news, you don’t need to! Those who played the original Punch Club will remember Silver’s Gym, the place where you could spend your hard earned money from Casey’s Pizza deliveries or your construction job in order to use the best, most modern training equipment available. Silver’s is still there, as is the titular man himself, and the place has had an upgrade! However, not to worry if you didn’t play the original, the game makes sure you’re all caught up with anything you need to know about the world and its characters - you’ll be meeting Silver soon enough!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661948/2728f402af30748690def024e9f033ab4c97f315.jpg

Silver’s Gym has installed state of the art Neurotraining equipment which allows you to pay for the machine to make you fitter, faster and stronger. In exchange for money, energy and some of your hunger meter and a little bit (or a lot) of time, you can run an unskippable program tailored to your current fitness needs. Even better? There’s no downside to this - you can run standard Neurotraining programs as often as you can afford and have time to do.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661948/b8bf0bf9370c49eb91b097d0b941fbd231ee9889.jpg


What's on the menu?
So let’s have a look at some of the programs available shall we? First up we have the Warm-Up: always a good way to start a session, this quick workout provides a balanced tone up for your whole body and gives a small amount of Strength, Agility and Stamina. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661948/dc610d5ba8621d9da50e0b5c87f5d52a283e46b3.jpg

Next up let’s have a look at something a bit more intensive and a bit more focused. Let’s say you want to target increasing your Stamina and money isn’t an issue for you - in this case you’ll want to try the Marathon program, which, in return for $30, 4 and a half hours and a whole load of hunger and energy will give you the sort of output a normal workout can only dream of! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661948/993bf2ef6093870bcf6df293b9db972e078e1ec3.jpg

There are programs dedicated to each of the three core attributes of Strength, Agility and Stamina, available for any budget! The more money you have, the more you can build up your stats! 


Taking it to the extreme
So those are the limitless benefits of ordinary neurotraing, where you can unleash your full potential without any drawbacks. However, legally, we're obligated to inform you that when you embark on the exhilarating journey of extreme neurotraining, there might be slight, medium, or serious brain overload. This can affect your rage and neurotraining effectiveness and can lead to degradation of the brains ability to do anything. But, let's face it, who cares about that right now? We'll give you a sneak peek of extreme neurotraining, but remember, it's our little secret.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661948/0c9262d5a0068412d924ddcdeb5f09b0700032b6.gif
Just lying in the comforts of a metal tube and gaining Strength, Agility, or Stamina - what could go wrong?

And that’s that for this week’s Dev Blog - but, extra good news, you can now go to our Steam Page and try the game out for yourself! That’s right, as of now, this second you are reading this, you can download the demo of Punch Club 2: Fast Forward, and try 45 minutes of the new gameplay! Go and download it now!

We’ll see you next week Champs!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1161590/Punch_Club_2_Fast_Forward

notes.title: First look at the Punch Club 2: Fast Forward gameplay
notes.content:
Hey there champs!
Welcome to the first of a series of dev blogs covering the game's many systems and mechanics. In this blog, we'll give you a bit more detail about how the basic gameplay mechanics of Punch Club 2: Fast Forward work. So, without further ado:

Managing The Balance Is Key
Just like in the original Punch Club, you’ll be balancing a number of meters representing your fighters' Health, Energy, Hunger and Rage - these stats are essential to maintain, as everything else is built on them. You’ll also be looking to earn GPP - Good Person Points, which allow you to purchase abilities for your fighter to use in the actual fights. 

Health, Energy and Hunger will all drop when you do various things - training, working, fighting etc. You’ll need to keep them all balanced as you go through the game, making sure to eat, rest and train to ensure that when you reach a fight, your fighter is in the best shape possible - a healthy and rested fighter is a better fighter! Learning to balance these meters in the early stages of the game will be one of your first challenges in Punch Club 2: Fast Forward. 

https://i.imgur.com/FUUcrcd.png

Rage affects almost everything you do, from how well you work to how well you train and fight. It drops while you work and if you miss a fight, and can be raised in a number of ways, including, but not limited to: consuming certain foods and drinks, watching TV, winning fights and going to movie nights. Keeping your Rage meter high will increase the efficiency of almost everything you do, so try to keep your fighter as satisfied as possible!

GPP - Your Corporate Mandated Social Score
GPP, or Good Person Points, are earned by *checks notes* winning fights? Apparently, as a fighter in the cyberpunk corporate dystopian nightmare you find yourself in, winning fights in your league shows how good a person you are, and the more fights you win, the better a person you must be! Maybe one day you’ll even earn enough points to get to the Upper City?

https://i.imgur.com/1KfXGDJ.jpg

Blood Sweat and Tears - If You Want
Once you’ve rested, fed and generally pampered your fighter, it’s now time to train! Training in the future can be done in one of two ways - old fashioned hard work, or super futuristic, no strings attached* (*there may be strings attached) Neurotraining. Unlike in the original Punch Club, your stats will not degrade (YES, WE KNOW), so you’ll never lose the work you’ve done!

Old fashioned training is much as you would expect- you can purchase various pieces of gym equipment for your garage, and then use those machines to train your fighter’s Strength, Agility and Stamina. Different equipment will affect different stats and can be bought from the Mafia at the Junkyard. 

https://i.imgur.com/iFGQlcd.gif

Neurotraining can be done at Silver’s Gym, and costs money as well as depleting your Hunger and Energy meters. There are various programs you can choose from, and there’s even Extreme Neurotraining for those who are rich and brave (or stupid) enough to try it. We'll talk more about this type of training later, but for now just imagine that you can fight a bear and get much stronger while lying in a warm capsule without moving a single muscle. How cool is that?

What It’s All Really About
All of your fighter’s life revolves around one thing - fights. Fights will allow you to earn GPP, progress up the ladder in your league and, of course, look really cool. 

Before a fight you choose your fighter's style from the options you have unlocked, and can slot in attacking and defensive moves, as well as various modifiers from the selection of things you have unlocked. Every fight is different, and the most successful fighters approach them as a puzzle - look at your opponents skills and see how you can counter them with your own. 

https://i.imgur.com/GY3zrTY.jpg

The World Is Cyberpunk Now?
But who is your fighter? Why do you care about their life? Well, the poor dude’s been locked in his house since he was born, his father missing and his overbearing mother never having let him leave the neighborhood. Now, that’s all going to change, because the food dispenser has broken and it’s either that, or our hero will starve! 

The city is a thriving, brightly lit neon hellscape which chews up the unwary and spits them out onto the junkheap. The corporation runs everything, people eat slime and pizza is extinct.

Also Apu is a head in a jar now. That’s also a thing. 

https://i.imgur.com/PnYKLFT.png

So, with that, we come to the end of our first Dev Blog, let us know what you think and make sure to wishlist Punch Club 2: Fast Forward now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1161590/Punch_Club_2_Fast_Forward/

notes.title: Punch Club 2: Fast Forward is coming in 2023!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6858705/2b24182ea2993056aee55aada2f5ce2b2094d537.png

In the not-too-distant future (or a parallel universe altogether?!), there's a town that seems achingly familiar, where everything seems to be just as you remember it... but at the same time, things have changed drastically.

The streets are covered in neon, police holograms patrol neighborhoods, the gym has a new neuro fitness machine, and... Wait is that a Jedi robot massage therapist?! 

Wishlist Now!
Punch Club 2: Fast Forward - the smashing sequel to your favorite fighter management sim is making its way to PC in 2023!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1161590/ 

Watch The New Trailer
[previewyoutube=1OWPiHZOMEM;full][/previewyoutube]
The Future Starts Now
The game events take place in a dystopian cyberpunk future. You will once again take on the role of a fighter, but this time, not only will you have to fight your way to the championship, but you will also have to uncover the darkest secrets of your family! What a twist.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6858705/76384c91ce8c9ec9d76a3007e49e3524372c0c62.gif

Train And Fight Your Way
The city is full of events and gangs ( or, well, 'fighting schools', call them what you like). Work out at home with dumbbells or in the gym on a neuro trainer (what?), bend girders in a junkyard (what?), work in a slime-beating factory (what?), watch the 80s and 90s action movies (oh yeah!) and fight your way to the top.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6858705/d8e7e4adc29f00ee7b8ae18a4cfe94d4109ddf40.gif

Prepare to witness an unforgettable story, fully loaded with humor and references to the 80-90s and set in the atmosphere of a cyberpunk future. Unique locations and characters, all in the form of gorgeous pixel art dream graphics, await you.
